summary: This bill reauthorizes and expands a grant program for food and agricultural sciences education by adding teaching enhancement projects, including paid work-based learning, as a priority and appropriating $60,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2026 through 2035.

scores.thoughts: The bill reauthorizes grants and fellowships for food and agricultural sciences education and explicitly authorizes $60,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2035, directly increasing government spending in this area.
